note: The user-controlled qname is split into localname and prefix; on the no-prefix path, prefix is left uninitialized by the libxml helper.

code: if (localname == NULL) { if (nsuri_len > 0) { ... return; } localname = xmlStrdup((xmlChar *)qname); }
note: The safety obligation is that prefix must be initialized before any later free; when qname has no prefix and nsuri_len is zero, the code falls through without setting prefix.
The destructor-style cleanup reaches a free on prefix even though prefix may contain an indeterminate value, causing an invalid free or sanitizer-detected use of uninitialized memory.
